audit.why: Sivir out-ranges/out-trades a short, unstacked Smolder early; the lane tips once his Q hits stack thresholds and he gets a crit/on-hit item.
Spikes: level 3 all-in window, level 6 (his R still under-stacked), his first crit/on-hit item is the real flip point.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d are copy-paste bleed (tradeGood/tradeBad pasted under unrelated titles), and breakdown.cooldowns has no cooldown numbers.
audit.why: Flap, Flap, Flap (E) is 24/22/20/18/16s and is his only terrain-crossing escape; Sivir's E Spell Shield should be saved for his MMOOOMMMM! (R) cast rather than chip Q poke, since blocking it heals/speeds her. Q (Super Scorcher Breath) deals true damage so resistances don't help, and R applies Grievous-Wounds-relevant sustain.

edits.before: Q the contact both ways, W-bounce the duo, walk — the trade taxed two people and refunded your mana bar.
edits.after: Bait his E dive or W sneeze, then Spell Shield it — a blocked cast heals you and speeds the punish.

edits.before: Spending E on chip damage and eating the engage it existed to eat — the shield is the matchup; spend it like a verdict.
edits.after: Taking a kill under his tower resets Dragon Practice stacks off your allies — grab the plate, not the trade.

edits.before: - Smolder Flap, Flap, Flap: matchup-defining — The glide over terrain is his whole escape — engage in the window after it shows. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Spell Shield has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Smolder Flap, Flap, Flap: 24/22/20/18/16s cooldown — his only escape over terrain; engage right after it lands, not before it shows. - Your E resets in 24-18s: save it for his R cast, not chip Q poke. - His R sits on 120/110/100s; punish the long window it's down.
